versions.changelog:
antibody-sequence-fto 1.0.0

- Initial release of antibody and biosequence patent search & FTO (Freedom To Operate) screening skill.
- Supports systematic FTO analysis for antibody protein sequences (HC/LC), including sequence BLAST, patent hit risk grading, and HTML report output.
- Delivers structured results: sequence comparison summary, risk tables by region (CDR/framework/Fc), landscape of target-related patents, and prioritized action recommendations.
- Designed to assist early-stage R&D and risk screening before detailed legal review.
- Results source-linked to PatSnap; only outputs factual content based on tool data.
